title: Portuguese Peanut Biscuits
description: A sweet and crunchy snack made with peanut flour, perfect for a quick dessert or snack.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together peanut flour, almond meal, and bake powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together coconut oil, honey, eggs, and salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes using a cookie cutter.
Place on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
